description.narrative: The Yap Renewable Energy Development Project (Project) supports development of the power system in State of Yap (Yap), Federated States of Micronesia (FSM) in order to reduce dependency on imported diesel through expansion of renewable power generation and improving the supply-side efficiencies of power delivery.
